field_classifications.basis: Field dates and setting: September 2019 survey/experiment in 15 rural villages in Kalehe, eastern DRC; hosting tracked for 10 months through July 2020.; Exact treatment and comparator: Control: brief possible-displacement message. Empathy: asked where respondent would go and what they would take if displaced. Authority: chief visit urging accommodation. Morality: Catholic leader visit invoking religious duty. Each crossed with ethnicity prime. Exact scripts, duration, and visit protocol: NR.; Outcome definitions and timing: (1) Survey response on willingness to host future IDPs, measured in the survey; exact item/coding NR. (2) Indicator of actual IDP hosting recorded by chiefs over the next 10 months. Other preregistered helping outcomes are mentioned but main results are excluded.

evidence.anchor: fielded in September 2019
evidence.paraphrase: The survey and embedded experiment were administered in 15 villages in Kalehe, South Kivu, eastern DRC in September 2019.
evidence.locator: Data and Empirical Strategy—Village Selection and Data Collection

evidence.anchor: same message preceded all other treatments
evidence.paraphrase: The control received a displacement-information message; empathy used perspective taking; authority and morality involved visits; each was crossed with own- versus other-ethnicity information.

evidence.anchor: two outcomes related to hosting
evidence.paraphrase: Table 4 analyzes survey willingness to host and village-chief-recorded actual hosting during the subsequent 10 months.
